meta.title: Bing Web Search
meta.description: Switches DSH web search from the DeepSeek official backend to Bing public endpoints, because the official search costs money: every web_search is a standalone DeepSeek model request billed against DEEPSEEK_API_KEY regardless of the selected chat model, so this cuts that billing path entirely (keyless, no login). International www.bing.com is tried first with cn.bing.com as fallback; the per-call row count is bounded by Bing and by the DSH tool cap (~8-10 measured).
